tool.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single PDF, in the given order. Provide at least two PDF sources; each source is either a URL or a `ref` to an uploaded PDF attachment.

inputs.description: Ordered list of PDF sources to merge. Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL of a PDF to fetch.

ref.description: Reference id of an uploaded PDF attachment.
